why.lead: Rentora started with a simple frustration: finding a home in Armenia often means noisy listings and details that should already be clear.
why.firstBody: Location, price per square metre, parking, amenities, building details and condition should be easy to understand before you need to ask.
why.closing: The goal is a clearer, faster and more informed home search.

what.lead: Rentora is an Armenian property platform for buying and renting, with the tools to understand a listing before contacting its owner.
what.secondBody: A listing can include price, location, photos, area, rooms, floor, condition and the amenities that matter for a decision.
what.thirdBody: New listings can be moderated before they are public. Owners can manage or archive their listings and view them on a map.

armenia.lead: Rentora is Armenia-first: a focused product for the way people here actually search for homes.
armenia.firstBody: Local city filters, address search and map discovery make location part of the decision. Rentora supports buying and renting.
armenia.thirdBody: As the product grows, it can develop local insights such as price trends, listing history and neighbourhood context.

about.lead: Rentora is an independent project from Gyumri, Armenia, built to make local property search more focused and useful.
about.secondBody: The product is being built feature by feature, proving that a focused local service can grow from a small beginning.
about.thirdTitle: A real product, not only a demo
about.thirdBody: The goal is to launch, learn from real use and improve from real feedback.
